results.title: Viral LinkedIn Post | 30-Minute Nap During Work Hours? Gen Z Candidate's Bold Interview Request Stuns Founder
results.description: A Gen Z job candidate's request for a 30-minute afternoon nap prompted a Noida-based CEO to reconsider traditional productivity metrics. The interaction, shared on LinkedIn, sparked a wider conversation about valuing outcomes over hours spent at a desk and the evolving expectations of the younger workforce.
